Rule.name: Emergency Identity - Provision Accounts
Rule.Description:
Disables or enables every account of an identity, without approvals. Called by the "Emergency Identity Status Management Workflow".
For each account (link): - authoritative applications (HR Authoritative CSV) are not changed - accounts already in the requested state are skipped - Enable is refused while the HR status is Terminated (leavers stay disabled) - LDAP ApacheDS: rule "LDAP ApacheDS - Set Account Status" (ApacheDS admin lock) - applications whose connector supports ENABLE: a Disable / Enable account request, executed by the IIQ provisioner with the application's Disable / Enable provisioning policies - anything else: reported as needing manual action
Inputs : identityName, action ("Disable" or "Enable"), launcher Returns: Map with "status" (SUCCESS, PARTIAL, FAILED or NOTHING_TO_DO) and "details" (one line per account)
